task_objective: Fix GitHub issues #19 (duplicate frontend router leaving window.DeckyBackend without listeners and suppressing install prompts) and #20 (single active WebSocket eviction loop stalling Loader calls up to 5 s), then open a pull request.
issues: #19: Frontend on Steam Stable has two routers: Decky listeners missing, install prompt never shows
#20: Single active socket: two routers evict each other and stall all Loader calls up to 5 s
tests_added: frontend/rollup.config.js: noEntryReimport build-time guard rejecting entry exports or chunk imports of entry chunks
tests/frontend/boot_router.test.mts: claimFrontendBoot succeeds once per context and blocks duplicate boots
tests/frontend/boot_router.test.mts: createClientId generates distinct non-empty client identifiers
tests/frontend/boot_router.test.mts: buildWsUrl encodes auth token and stable client_id query parameter
design_decisions: Root cause of #19: commit ea72222 statically imported IS_ESM_CLIENT from ./stable/client in frontend/src/index.ts while Toast.tsx also statically imports it, causing Rollup to export I from index.js and emit import { I as IS_ESM_CLIENT } from './index.js' in the start.tsx chunk. Because CEF loads index.js?v=<version>, ./index.js evaluated as a second ES module and constructed a second WSRouter that overwrote window.DeckyBackend after PluginLoader registered listeners on router #1.

Inlined the one-line ESM client check in frontend/src/index.ts (keeping zero extra boot HTTP hops while keeping src/stable/client.ts private to the start.tsx chunk), added an idempotent claimFrontendBoot guard before any await, and added a Rollup noEntryReimport plugin so no future change can make any chunk import index.js.

Kept bootGuard.ts private to index.ts and wsUrl.ts private to wsrouter.ts so Rollup never shares them across entry and lazy chunks, and registered both in SDK_OVERLAYS in scripts/runtime/prepare_bundle.py.

Replaced the single active WebSocket and global PendingCalls map in backend-rust/src/transport.rs with a unified per-session SessionRegistry under one mutex (no .await held under lock). Each WSRouter sends a stable per-instance client_id so same-client reconnects replace only their own prior socket and preserve FULL_SYNC deduplication, while distinct or concurrent anonymous clients coexist without evicting each other, route call replies strictly to the originating session, isolate FULL_SYNC pruning per session, and all receive broadcast backend events.
Bounded disconnected session retention with immediate removal when pending calls are empty, a 60 s TTL, and a 16-session cap.

results.frontend_build_typecheck_lint: passed (index.js has zero exports and zero chunks import ./index.js)
